moments.title: Halloween countdown begins
moments.blurb: With Halloween on Saturday, October 31st, various spooky events and half-term activities are ramping up across the UK.

angles.name: Spooky Season
angles.copy: It's officially spooky season! Halloween is just around the corner, what are your plans for the scariest night of the year?
